# Aptos Labs on GitHub Pages

> Landing for documentation hosted directly from Aptos Labs source repositories. The canonical Aptos developer site is at https://aptos.dev.

## Documentation

- [Move on Aptos Book](https://aptos-labs.github.io/move-book/): Reference for the Move language as used on Aptos, including the Move Specification Language and Move Prover. Published from aptos-core; content may reflect the configured source ref used for the build.
- [Aptos Framework Book](https://aptos-labs.github.io/framework-book/): Reference for every on-chain Move module — the Move standard library, the Aptos standard library, and the framework packages. Root URL tracks aptos-framework branch main; explicit channels: [main](https://aptos-labs.github.io/framework-book/main/), [mainnet](https://aptos-labs.github.io/framework-book/mainnet/), [testnet](https://aptos-labs.github.io/framework-book/testnet/), [devnet](https://aptos-labs.github.io/framework-book/devnet/).

## External

- [Aptos developer documentation](https://aptos.dev): Full developer site (canonical).
- [Aptos Labs on GitHub](https://github.com/aptos-labs): Source repositories.

## Optional

- [Markdown homepage](https://aptos-labs.github.io/index.md): Markdown representation of the landing page for agents.
